question: Can an issue's author's permission be read in the listing of open issues, and who added and who removed each label, with the time, in the full read?
pass: Yes to both, within the budget P-8 measures (section 6). Read here, as the Maintainer's working ruling on #13 asks, in the same read as P-8's: the listing of open issues gives each author's association with the repo as the reader App sees it, and that association tells an author with write access from one without, as section 4.1 needs ("whether that author has write access"); and each labeled and unlabeled event on an issue is read with the actor who made it, by login and kind, and when.

headers.x-oauth-scopes: admin:org, admin:org_hook, delete_repo, gist, read:packages, read:project, repo, workflow
